fixtures.source: Only original S0 saved parents cases0,1,2 and deterministic tiny synthetic policy/environment fixtures. No new map/task seed.

fixtures.small: Existing S0 subset targets or hand-defined tiny C/D/F data; mock terminal returns explicitly labeled, no true H/export; never used as formal teacher labels.

budget_enforcement: Pre-debit every real Adam.step and real terminal attempt to append-only fsynced journal. All runs, failures and retries cumulatively count. Source revisions require new pre-run binding receipt and remain under same total ceiling; no automatic cap increase.
source_binding: A separate immutable execution-binding JSON records final implementation and verification script hashes immediately BEFORE any executed acceptance. This registration is a test plan, not approval of v3 or formal training.
success: All numerical/lineage/restore/gate checks pass with no unexpected scientific fixture failures and all caps respected; scientific performance untested.
failure: Preserve failures and checkpoints/logs; repair only semantically identical bugs and rebind revision before rerun if cap remains. No seed/case replacement, reward-zero rescue, formal S2 or S3.
